disclaimer: Automated checks provide engineering design assistance and require verification by a licensed Architect/Engineer before municipal submission.

sources.applicability: Standard residential greenfield; separate congested/non-congested and corporation/remaining authority tables. Purchased rights and scheme/local amendments require review.
Congested: original holding/height exceptions. Non-congested: road band and city class, H/5 only above table height/floor limits; special buildings require separate review.

Layout/group housing and original holding rules; net area after road/reservation deductions, approved layout exemptions; dedicated accessible ROS (10m minimum, aspect <=2.5 if width <20m), not residual margins.

Apartment carpet bands, 5% visitors and city/class car factors (not apartment two-wheelers); fractions strictly above 0.5 round up; standard marked stalls; no automatic composite/mechanical substitution.
Standard apartment habitable/kitchen sizes are owner requirements; bath/WC minima and clear heights are statutory. NBC sizes require separate verification.
Habitable/kitchen openings >=1/10 floor area, wet ventilation >=0.30 m2; adjacency and shaft size mandatory; depth beyond 7.5m requires further assessment.

Residential travel 22.5m; stair clear widths 1.0/1.2/1.5m by height. Project brief separately requires 1.5m. Residential tread 250mm/riser 190mm/headroom 2.2m. Fire enclosure and special-building applicability require review.
Official edition confirmed; original licensed clause text and local adoption/amendments have not been verified. No NBC compliance result may be inferred from UDCPR checks.
Explicit requested stricter 1500mm stair and 6000/3600mm driveway policy; not presented as a UDCPR/NBC quotation.

rulesChecked.description: Jurisdiction, scheme and post-2025 amendments reviewed
rulesChecked.remediation: Confirm the standard greenfield scheme and current local/amendment applicability. Source snapshot is pinned to 2025-01-30.

rulesChecked.description: NBC Part 3 and Part 4 clause verification
rulesChecked.remediation: Verify original NBC 2016 clauses and local adoption. UDCPR measurements do not establish NBC compliance.

rulesChecked.description: Physical residential/stilt/roof roles are explicit
rulesChecked.remediation: Assign floorUse; roof drawing sheets must not be counted as residential storeys.

rulesChecked.description: Physical level count agrees with the regulatory input
rulesChecked.remediation: Reconcile physical storeys and the brief; drawing-only roof sheets are excluded.

rulesChecked.description: Explicit stilt flag agrees with physical floor roles
rulesChecked.remediation: Reconcile stilt parking inputs with physical floor roles.

rulesChecked.description: Canonical disjoint centreline-cell ledger (no unassigned or overlap)
rulesChecked.remediation: Resolve unsupported polygons, overlaps or unassigned ledger cells; no area rounding is used.

rulesChecked.description: Covered roof structures and roof FSI applicability reviewed
rulesChecked.remediation: Review roof structure sections; a roof drawing is not automatically an exempt floor.

rulesChecked.description: Basic / premium / TDR / ancillary potential (not purchased rights)
rulesChecked.remediation: Review this clause with a licensed Architect/Engineer.

rulesChecked.description: Premium, TDR, ancillary approvals and net plot deductions
rulesChecked.required: Explicit approved rights within source caps
rulesChecked.remediation: Supply netPlotAreaSqm and separately reviewed approvedPremiumFsi, approvedTdrFsi and approvedAncillaryFsi (explicit zero permitted).

rulesChecked.description: Reviewed exempt areas; measured core/stilt are only candidates
rulesChecked.required: Explicit floor areas and exemption clauses
rulesChecked.remediation: Review FSI exemptions, including explicit none; never auto-exempt an entire core/stilt by name.

rulesChecked.description: Net FSI consumed without a 1% overrun allowance
rulesChecked.remediation: Reduce reckonable area or provide reviewed entitlements/exemptions; exact unrounded ratio is compared.

rulesChecked.description: Measured front outer wall / plinth clearance
rulesChecked.remediation: Table 6-D + 6.2.3 H/5 above table limits; special-building/fire-access review is separate. Rectangular single-road plots only; supply edge roles/street centreline for unsupported sites.

rulesChecked.description: Measured rear outer wall / plinth clearance
rulesChecked.remediation: Table 6-D + 6.2.3 H/5 above table limits; special-building/fire-access review is separate. Rectangular single-road plots only; supply edge roles/street centreline for unsupported sites.

rulesChecked.description: Measured left outer wall / plinth clearance
rulesChecked.remediation: Table 6-D + 6.2.3 H/5 above table limits; special-building/fire-access review is separate. Rectangular single-road plots only; supply edge roles/street centreline for unsupported sites.

rulesChecked.description: Measured right outer wall / plinth clearance
rulesChecked.remediation: Table 6-D + 6.2.3 H/5 above table limits; special-building/fire-access review is separate. Rectangular single-road plots only; supply edge roles/street centreline for unsupported sites.

rulesChecked.description: Plinth ground coverage (independent of ROS)
rulesChecked.remediation: Confirm applicable ground-coverage restrictions; residual plot area is never counted as ROS.

rulesChecked.description: Dedicated non-overlapping ROS with 10m minimum dimension and aspect limits and access
rulesChecked.remediation: Designate reviewed ROS polygons, verify independent/common access, original holding and DP/RP deductions. A generic garden or residual driveway is not certified ROS.

rulesChecked.description: Per-unit measured carpet including internal partitions
rulesChecked.required: RERA 2(k) geometry convention; explicit wall ownership
rulesChecked.remediation: Resolve wall classifications/ownership and verify the carpet convention for the parking schedule.

rulesChecked.description: No marked car or two-wheeler stalls exist
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide actual marked stalls and a verified parking schedule.

rulesChecked.description: Valid non-overlapping 2500 x 5000mm car bays
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide marked accessible car stalls, reviewed unit carpet areas and the correct Table 8-C city/class factor.

rulesChecked.description: Valid non-overlapping 1000 x 2000mm two-wheeler bays
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide actual marked two-wheeler stalls; the software does not invent provided counts.

rulesChecked.description: Measured driveway width against requested project policy
rulesChecked.remediation: Tag dedicated driveway polygons and specify traffic flow. Verify manoeuvring, connectivity and source 8.1.1(iv) separately; source minimum car drive is 3m.

rulesChecked.description: Street access / turning and stilt beam clearance
rulesChecked.required: Verified access geometry and 2.4m below beams
rulesChecked.remediation: Verify connected street access, swept paths and section headroom; width alone is insufficient.

rulesChecked.description: At least one canonical staircase per physical floor
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide canonical staircase and OPEN_PASSAGE circulation access.

rulesChecked.description: Constrained room/door/corridor route: No canonical staircase.
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide complete door topology and unobstructed common circulation to OPEN_PASSAGE. Residential limit is 22.5m; no assumed 18m or 30m.

rulesChecked.description: Measured lift shaft provision
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide required lift shafts and verify lift capacity/accessibility; lifts are not fire exits.

rulesChecked.description: Explicit clear room height below slab/beam
rulesChecked.remediation: Supply measured section clear height; floor-to-floor height alone does not establish clearance.

rulesChecked.description: Clear area / width / aspect: Living Room
rulesChecked.required: UDCPR 9.2.1 / 9.3.1 owner requirements; NBC review pending
rulesChecked.remediation: Record wet-room subtype for bath/WC minima; verify NBC room sizes. Do not misquote owner-convenience provisions as numerical statutory minima.

rulesChecked.description: Actual exterior/balcony/shaft window openings: Living Room
rulesChecked.remediation: Provide hosted window width/height, outdoor adjacency, adequate shafts and depth/light assessment; opening area alone is insufficient.

rulesChecked.description: Vertical canonical staircase footprint alignment
rulesChecked.remediation: Align canonical cores across physical floors; separately verify landings, flight direction and vertical clearances.

rulesChecked.description: Special-building classification, exit capacity, enclosure and fire systems
rulesChecked.required: Verified fire strategy and section data
rulesChecked.remediation: Obtain professional fire/accessibility review; planar egress measurements do not verify enclosure, smoke protection, exit capacity or required second exits.
